subject: planner: Reduce topn/buckets for lower NDV (#59929)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent. The only runtime change is in `pkg/statistics/builder.go` (`BuildHistAndTopN`): more aggressive pruning of singleton TopN entries (once enough TopN entries exist) and adaptive reduction of histogram bucket count when TopN is pruned and `numBuckets==256`. This only affects stats shape and cardinality estimation/EXPLAIN outputs (as reflected in updated test golden files) and does not change SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session behavior, or data consistency. No Blocker/High correctness or runtime-safety issues found in the touched planner/statistics behavior; later history on `upstream/master` contains further tuning commits in the same area but nothing that clearly indicates a follow-up correctness fix for this change.
